verdict.rationale: The provider docs say OpenClaw works with many LLM providers, and one hands-on community report describes running OpenClaw with local models. No evidence names Ollama, llama.cpp, LM Studio or vLLM, and none confirms a fully cloud-free setup. missing for 10: first-party documentation of the named local backends (Ollama, llama.cpp, LM Studio, vLLM), confirmation that no cloud model dependency remains, local-model setup guidance, more independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a privacy-first user, I can run the assistant entirely on local models — Ollama, llama.cpp, LM Studio, or vLLM — with no cloud model dependency

citations.quote: OpenClaw can use many LLM providers. Pick a provider, authenticate, then set the default model as `provider/model`.
A user runs OpenClaw in a NixOS QEMU VM with local models in a config-based sandbox
